correctness.rationale: For the corrected claim, the radial L2 norm squared is at most 4 pi/3 by s=tanh r. The half-line cosine transform of sech is (pi/2) sech(pi s/2), obtained independently from the beta integral after v=e^(2r). Integration by parts against the derivative of sech and product-to-sum give the stated transform and exponential decay. Writing F(s)=s sech(c s) for c=pi/2, the transform is pi^2 times [F(omega+lambda)-F(omega-lambda)]/lambda. It is even and the continuous zero value is 2 pi^2 F'(omega), whose sign is that of 1-c omega tanh(c omega). For lambda>0, combining the translated cosh denominators leaves the sign of lambda coth(c lambda)-omega tanh(c omega). The first function increases strictly from 1/c to infinity because sinh(x) cosh(x)>x for x>0; the second increases from zero to infinity. This gives the inclusive cutoff, unique positive zero beyond it, and full repaired sign including lambda=0. The continuous L2 radial profile and integrable transform meet the L2-Godement hypotheses; the supercritical interval has positive Plancherel measure. An independently written decimal bisection using the exponential form of tanh and Machin's pi formula corroborated omega*=0.76373914287512802042949…; this calculation was not needed to certify the analytic sign.
residual_risks: No formal certificate or independently recomputed finite-configuration witness is necessary here; the L2 positivity equivalence establishes the universal statement and its converse.

evidence: For a=2, Appendix B yields 2 pi^2 sech(pi lambda/2) at omega=0. The frozen and repaired claims additionally analyze the sign when the two frequency shifts straddle zero. value.rationale: This is an exact admissibility boundary for a natural modulated version of an established radial H^3 kernel. It decides whether a distance profile works on every configuration and, on failure, specifies the entire forbidden spectral band, including its single positive boundary. A Euclidean computation or the unmodulated theorem cannot substitute; strict monotonicity after combining two shifted terms yields both directions and the inclusive threshold. The corrected zero-frequency sign completes the classification without enlarging the scientific claim beyond this profile.
residual_risks: No conclusion about other decay powers or hyperbolic dimensions is claimed.
